sections.html:
The Emerald cichlid has become a bit out of fashion. This is a rather sad thing, because this impressive large cichlid is one of the most beautiful cichlid species of South America. Males can grow up to 30 cm long, while females always stay much smaller.

Common name: Emerald cichlid. Origin: captive-bred. Available size: 5-6 cm.
Specimens bred in Germany of the population from the Rio Oyapoc are now available. The splendid red colours make it look like an artificial sport, but this is a true wild form.
Hypselecara means "deep-bodied Acara"; Acara is the Tupi word for cichlid. temporalis means "with a high forehead".
